name: Bastion
description:
When in a zone, or carrying an offering/banner, gain 10% damage resistance. 

Zones include capture points in Dominion, and archer points, healing zones, and near the ram in Breach.
explanation: Beneficial for stalling in Dominion. Extremely practical in Breach, where the Healing Zone, nearby ram, and archer lane are all considered objectives.

name: Vengeful Barrier
description: When exiting revenge, gain a +25 HP shield for 15 seconds.
explanation:
This perk is easily the best defense perk, and rewards you even more for obtaining revenge. A must-have for any character with it available.

The addition of a timer for the shield duration is hardly a nerf, as you're normally still fighting when you exit revenge.

name: Last Stand
description: When in critical health ( <25 HP), gain 40% damage resistance.
explanation:
This perk is quite good, with frequent debates about using it or Bulk Up, the perk combos incredibly well with Vengeful Barrier and shield feats, as they do not count towards the critical health threshold, giving you a massive amount of damage reduced health. This perk doesn't synergise too well with Bastion or Hard to Kill, considering that damage resistance does NOT stack.

The perk is only triggered once you are actually at critical health, so attacks that would kill from above critical health will not be reduced, (eg. a 30 damage heavy will still kill you from 30 hp) although this is less of a downside now that attacks do less damage overall.	

The damage resistance provides an effective ~10HP boost once you are in critical, but the mental play of 40% damage resistance should not be ignored, as many players will neglect to try calculate their reduced damage, leading to them feeding revenge in an attempt to finish you off - allowing the script to be easily reversed.

name: Bulk Up
description:
Gain +4 HP maximum health per renown level. 

Maximum +16 HP at max renown level.
explanation:
A consistent and reliable health increase, this perk is pretty good, with it's only downside being that you typically have to choose between this and Last Stand.

This perk doesn't synergise with the revenge shield bug, but does allow for more riskier plays/trades with the extra +16 HP.

name: Remedy
description: Upon Hero kill, gain +10 HP. Must land the final hit to count.
explanation: This perk is decent because of its generic use, and usually because alternatives are simply inferior. Synergizes extremely well with Head Hunter and Devourer to give you an increased value out of execution healing.

name: Feline Agility
description:
Gain +4% movement speed when reaching renown level 1, and +2% for each subsequent level. 

Maximum +10% movement speed at max renown level.
explanation: This perk is very mediocre due to the low movespeed bonuses and being gated by renown level, which is especially a concern in Dominion. Not terrible, but outshined by many other feats typically.

name: Rising Dawn
explanation:
This perk is good, especially on heroes with revive-related feats (e.g Speed Revive and Protected Revive). Valuable in Breach, as HP is a commodity.

Providing an extra 25% on all revives makes them somewhat worth-while in Dominion, meaning that you could try to get more renown from revives.
